exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) in both pregnancies
GDM in first pregnancy but not in subsequent pregnancy
cohort: The study included 19,703 individuals with at least two consecutive births at a tertiary medical center between July 2012 and December 2022, categorized by their gestational diabetes mellitus status in consecutive pregnancies.
finding: Individuals with a history of gestational diabetes mellitus in a previous pregnancy but not in a subsequent pregnancy are at increased risk of diabetes-related complications, including preeclampsia, macrosomia, and large for gestational age.
mod_finding: Elective cesarean delivery rates were higher in both groups with previous GDM (group 1 and group 2) compared to the no GDM group (group 3), with the highest rates observed in those with GDM in both pregnancies.
gest_age: Preterm birth, large for gestational age
